Hi Linda / Sanjay —

Thanks for a great discovery today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC plan this week. Attaching a first-pass statement of work and a short network checklist for your infra team.

Key success criteria (please confirm or add):
- Latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 300ms for 512-token requests under a 5 qps load.
- Throughput: sustained 50 RPS peak for 10m window with graceful degradation.
- Output quality: top-3 prompts pass the example rubric you shared (intent preservation + hallucination tolerance).
- Data controls: customer data never leaves their VPC during inferences (private deployment option).

Evaluation plan / timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (this week): network readiness check + finalize SOW (you/Redwood).
- Week 1: private deployment prep + baseline tests (infra owner + Redwood infra).
- Week 2: run evaluation prompts, quality checks, and cost profiling.
- Week 3: review results and decision meeting (go/no-go).

Ownership ask: can your team confirm internal owners for these domains so we can produce a RACI? Suggested internal owners below based on today's call — we can adjust:
- Infra / networking: Elliotsys (Sanjay)
- App integration / feature owner: Elliotsys (Linda)
- Security / compliance sign-off: Elliotsys sec team (TBD)
- Procurement / purchase orders: Elliotsys procurement (TBD)

Redwood suggested owners (we'll carry execution):
- Redwood infra lead: Karthik Iyer
- Redwood security liaison: Marissa Cole
- Redwood sales / procurement contact: Vanessa Ortiz / Ben Carter

Attachments: [Attachment: trial-sow-v1.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: network-checklist.csv (text/csv)]

Ask: Please confirm the success criteria above and share the names/emails for your infra and procurement owners by EOD Friday so we can finalize the kickoff date.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Thanks Vanessa — helpful summary. Confirming the high-level criteria look correct; a couple of additions from our side:
- Data residency: for this POC we need all inference traffic to originate and stay within our us-west-2 VPC (we'll need a short-run VPC peering / PrivateLink plan).
- KMS integration: we use AWS KMS for key management and will want to validate key access patterns (read-only to Redwood runtime).

Our owners:
- Infra / networking: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@elliotsys.com>
- App integration: Linda Park <linda.park@elliotsys.com>
- Security / compliance: Aisha Fernandez (sec@elliotsys.com) — will loop her into the SOW once we have the network checklist
